# Clinic Conduct Policy

## 1 Consent

A telehealth visit may only begin after the patient has agreed to a remote consultation.

## 2 Recording

A remote consultation must not be recorded unless the patient agrees in writing.

## 3 Prescribing

A clinician must not prescribe a controlled drug in a first remote consultation.

## 4 Identity

The clinician must confirm the patient's identity before sharing any result.

## 5 Emergencies

When a patient describes an emergency, the clinician must direct them to emergency services.
